name: independent_component_amplitude_randomization
mechanism: Randomizes the amplitudes of individual waveform components independently rather than applying a global scale, increasing morphological diversity and simulating varying electrical axes.

name: cardiac_axis_vector_projection
mechanism: Calculates multi-lead ECG wave amplitudes by projecting a 2D cardiac electrical vector onto specific lead angles, ensuring physiologically consistent inter-lead relationships.
code_snippet: r_amp_I = qrs_mag * np.cos(axis_rad); r_amp_II = qrs_mag * np.cos(axis_rad - np.radians(60))

name: expand_stochastic_parameter_ranges
mechanism: Widens the uniform distribution bounds for physiological vectors, waveform morphologies, and noise components to increase inter-sample diversity and reduce mode collapse.

name: randomize_gaussian_waveform_widths
mechanism: Replaces fixed standard deviation constants with uniformly sampled random variables for the widths of Gaussian wave components to increase inter-sample morphological diversity.

name: randomize_waveform_component_widths
mechanism: Introduces stochastic variation to the temporal widths of individual waveform components and inter-wave intervals to increase morphological diversity and reduce inter-sample similarity.
code_snippet: p_sigma = np.random.uniform(0.015, 0.025); lead_I += gaussian_wave(t, beat_t - pr_interval, p_sigma, p_amp_I)
